results.instruction: Set up a warning triangle and turn on the hazard lights.
Apply the parking brake, put the car in park, switch off the ignition, and ensure all passengers exit the vehicle.
Retrieve the spare wheel and tools from the trunk.
Use the tool provided to remove the hubcap if the wheel has one.
Use the wrench to loosen the wheel nuts one half to one turn before jacking up the vehicle.
Place the jack under the vehicle's jacking point and raise the car until the flat tire clears the ground.
Remove the wheel nuts and take off the flat tire.
Lift the spare wheel onto the hub, line up the holes, and replace the wheel nuts, tightening them until firm.
Lower the jack until the spare wheel touches the ground, then tighten the wheel nuts firmly in sequence.
Lower the car completely, remove the jack, and store the tools and flat tire.
